history.event: Claude refinement: 25 line(s) suggested — Mostly garbled common words restored from context and the image (mitocho, vigna, sopra/sopradecta, fossatello, balduccio, cella, mia, podere, decta, sieme), plus the florin sign (ƒ 60), cħ for 1̄ħ, and the final punctuation and closing marks the reading had dropped. | layout: l2: the large initial E sits just left of the orange outline; I added it to the text (as in l14).; l18: the large initial E is mostly outside the outline; I added it to the text.; l1, l4, l11, l12, l13: these are marginal headings (l1+l4 for the first entry, l11 for the second, l12+l13 for the third); in reading order each should come before its section, but here they are numbered between the main-text lines.; l10: the date sits at the right end of l9's line and belongs to l9 (adi 1488 …); the words after the figure are in fainter ink, maybe added later. | doubts: l1: marginal heading, maybe 'lauigna dauiler'; the second word is unclear.; l6: 'vigna de Andrea' is a guess; the name is unclear.; l7: the word after 'girolamo di' (fran°? firen°?) is unclear.; l8: the sign before 60 looks like ff (florins); I wrote ƒ under the florin rule. Please check 'ꝓ ꝓgio' (pregio) against the image.; l10: the last figure of the year looks like 8 but the manuscript is from the 1460s (1468?); the faint words after it are unreadable to me.; l16: I left the roman numerals (iiº, iiiº) unchanged as the rules require; the image may show a final j (aij°, aiij°). The brother's name (marcho?) is unclear.; l19: 'pieve di muisa' is uncertain; the Kraken reading was 'ꝓbre di muisa'.; l20: 'da ß baldo' is read on the model of l24; 'chome[?]' could be chomesso or similar.; l21: one 'ꝓte' near the start looks struck through ([del:]?); I did not mark it.; l23: 'podere da sale' and the closing 'alpste' (al presente) need checking.; l24: 'a metre' could be 'a meta' (half); unclear.
